_meta.name: LGU Portal
_meta.description: Three-layer token system for the LGU SSO portal. Dark glassmorphism by default: the `semantic` layer IS the dark theme so the app renders dark with no class toggling. This portal ships one theme; a second theme would be a sibling `semantic` block overriding the same names, and components would not change because they read the semantic layer.

layers.primitive: Raw values. No meaning. Rarely changes.
layers.semantic: Purpose aliases. Change these to re-theme.
layers.component: Per-component overrides. Change these to restyle one part.
